## Ojbective function:
## A1, A2, A3 (plant A and warehouse 1,2,3), B1, B2, B3 (plant B and warehouse 1,2,3)
## Objective: 622XA1 + 614xA2 + 630xA3 + 641xB1 + 645xB2 + 649xB3
## Constraints:
## Plant A capacity: xA1 + xA2 + xA3 ≤ 100
## Plant B capacity: xB1 + xB2 + xB3 ≤ 120
## AED Demand: XA1 + XB1 = 80, XA2 + XB2 = 60, XA3 + XB3 = 70
## XAED ≥ 0



## Name rows



```{r}
plants <- c("Plant A", "Plant B")
warehouses <- c("WH1", "WH2", "WH3")


```

## shipping and production cost, constraints per plant, demands per warehouse

```{r}
shipcosts <- matrix(c(22, 14, 30, 16, 20, 24), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, dimnames = list(plants, warehouses))
product_costs <- c(600, 625)
plant_capacity <- c(100, 120)
plant_demand   <- c(80, 60, 70)


```

## total costs for shipping and production for each unit

```{r}
total_costs <- shipcosts + product_costs
total_costs


```


## supply and demand constraints

```{r}
objective_function <- lp.transport(cost.mat   = total_costs, direction  = "min", row.signs  = rep("<=", 2), row.rhs = plant_capacity, col.signs  = rep("=",  3), col.rhs = plant_demand)

```

## shipping solution

```{r}
shipping <- objective_function$solution
dimnames(shipping) <- list(plants, warehouses)


```

## print solution; AEDs totals at each plant
## print solution; Plant capacity will reflect 10 unused AEDs remaining at plant B
## print solution; two shipping options to plant A and B, including 10 unused AEDs to plant B reflect same 
## costs, meaning two optimal shipping options to plant A and plant B; cost to both = same $132,790.

```{r}
cat("\nUnits produced: Plant A =", sum(shipping[1, ]),
    " Plant B =", sum(shipping[2, ]), "\n")


cat("Unused capacity: Plant A =", plant_capacity[1] - sum(shipping[1, ]),
    " Plant B =", plant_capacity[2] - sum(shipping[2, ]), "\n")

cat("Minimum total cost: $", format(objective_function$objval, big.mark = ","), "\n")




```
